A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the fixed-bed adsorption process is an excellent method to be used in industrial effluent treatment and the proposed adsorbent (PEI-Py) can be considered as a good alternative for the treatment of industrial effluents containing high concentrations of organic compounds.
the proposed fixed-bed column adsorbent (Diatomite-PEI-PY nanoparticles) was successfully used for the removal of total organic carbon (TOC) from real industrial wastewater.
the fixed-bed column adsorptive process using Diatomite decorated with PEI-PY nanoparticles is an excellent method to treat industrial wastewaters with high organic loadings and low concentrations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Diatomite/PEI-PY composite can be successfully used to remove organic pollutants in a fixed-bed column.
the use of Diatomite as support material for PEI-PY nanoparticles can improve the adsorption performance in the fixed-bed column system.
the fixed-bed column adsorber can be used for the treatment of industrial wastewater with the removal efficiency of 98.5% at the inlet concentration of 50 mg/L and the bed height of 10 cm.
